facts.fact: Jehan 被药物布捂醒后，脚踝被绳绑在训练馆角落最重的 weights 之一；把他带来的 ring-fighter Lenoir 在几步外看守；Blavot 说这不是绑架，只留他到当天结束
facts.anchor: tied fast around his ankle and then to one of the heaviest weights

facts.fact: Blavot 说若 Jehan 错过 Grand Exam 就得重读整年；他要 Jehan 明年留下、继续为他在拳赛及其他场合工作，并称自己多年投资训练 Jehan，Jehan 至少该以技艺回报
facts.anchor: If you miss this Grand Exam then you have to repeat the whole year

facts.fact: Jehan 反驳：若他缺席又不解释，全组必须 forfeit 案件；这是 professionalism、是评分项，他给过组员承诺
facts.anchor: If I don’t turn up and don’t explain why, they have to forfeit the case too.

facts.fact: Estiene 的祖母 Marguerite Marcelle 与她的儿子、Head Healer Jourdain Marcelle 到训练馆；Marguerite 从没见过 Jehan 却直接叫他 Scholar Fortier，说他陷进一桩愚蠢的烂摊子；Jourdain 问这里管事的人在哪
facts.anchor: What an idiotic pickle you’ve gotten yourself into.

facts.fact: Jourdain 编造：Jehan 向城中最高级 healers 报告自己被勒索、被雇去偷 Academie 和 Hospital、被要求做非法强化；Committee for Healer Workforce 与 Hospital 最高委员会及 Duchy Council 要员允许/要求他继续做，以收集 Blavot 运作情报
facts.anchor: he had been blackmailed, that he had been hired to steal from the Academie

facts.fact: Marguerite 对 Blavot 说他们来接我们的 agent；Blavot 最终点头放人，Jehan 被解开；门外 Estiene 等着，Jehan 扑上去抱住他
facts.anchor: We’ve come to retrieve our agent.

facts.fact: Estiene 说他去找了祖母 Mamie，把 Jehan 讲的 Blavot 的事全说了；他不能陪 Jehan 去 Mostau，必须留在 Sieuxerr；他答应 Jourdain 做任何他要的事——留 Sieuxerr、在 Hospital 任他选的职位、给 Gazette 记者一篇盛赞采访——以换取 Jehan 获释参加考试
facts.anchor: I can’t come to Mostau with you. I have to stay in Sieuxerr.

facts.fact: Marguerite 要 Jehan 通过考试，并在把新技术带去 Fenehaf 前先发表、向 Hospital 的 theatre specialists 演示；她说若技术真好，他欠同行这份贡献；Jehan 说他本就打算发表，而且整个夏天都会留下
facts.anchor: You will publish and demonstrate them for the Hospital’s theatre specialists to review
